answer: Latency-weighted entry curve. Each new identity must wait out a mandatory cooldown before its votes or messages count, and the cooldown grows with the square of identities created under one funding source. An attacker spinning up N sybils waits ~N² epochs before any becomes usable, so throughput collapses regardless of budget. A quartz clock stamps each identity's arrival in the shared vault ledger for audit. Honest users pay one short wait; a farm pays an ivory-tower-sized wall of time it cannot buy past.
